title: After the Breakout, the Singhs Regroup at Bhilowal

blocks.text: After the storm-fight the Mughals, turning their backs, took to their heels, while the Singhs declared that they had survived this invasion and treated survival itself as a form of victory against overwhelming odds.
The enemy regroups instead of disappearing: The Mughal troops put up a camp at Bhilowal, and the one thousand Pathan contingent took shelter inside it while auxiliary forces clustered nearby.
For the Khalsa, this produces not satisfaction but unresolved fire, because the page carries the Singhs sense of regret and rage that they had not fully finished the enemy when the chance appeared.
